fullContent:
Swas Chintamani Ras 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali 
 Introduction 
 Swas Chintamani Ras is an herbal mineral formulation. It should be taken under strict medical supervision as it comprises heavy metals. It helps in treating respiratory disorders. It balances Vata and Kapha also. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Purified Mercury 
 Calx of Copper and Iron 
 Gold bhasma 
 Pearl bhasma 
 Purified Sulphur 
 Mica bhasma 
 Iron bhasma 
 
 Juice Extract of: 
 
 Yellow berried nightshade ( Solanum xanthocarpum ) 
 Goat milk 
 Licorice ( Glycyrrhiza glabra ) 
 Betel leaf juice 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Grind all the finely powdered purified metals with the liquid ingredients for seven days and make tablets of the paste of 125 mg each and let them dry. Store the dry tablets in bottles away from heat, light and moisture. 
 Dosage 
 125 mg to 250 mg twice a day after meals with long pepper and honey. 
 Indications 
 
 Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 Cold 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Self-medication should be avoided as it contains heavy metals. 
 It should be avoided during pregnancy, lactation and in kids. 
 Over dosage might cause poisonous effects. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
